transcript_only_text:
The  majority  of  businesses  in  the  US  do 
 not  make  money.  Over  half  either  lose 
 money  or  break  even  every  year.  Profit 
 is  unnatural.  It's  not  a  normally 
 occurring  thing.  You  have  to  force  it 
 and  you  have  to  keep  the  line  because 
 people  will  spend  your  money  happily. 
 Having  that  kind  of  discipline  is 
 difficult.  It's  a  discipline.  Profit  is 
 a  discipline.
